description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Amumu''' throws a bandage in the target direction that deals magic damage to the first enemy hit, [[File:Stun icon.png|20px|link=Stun|An icon representing the keyword Stun]] [[:Stun|stunning]] them for 1 second and [[File:Dash.png|20px|link=Dash|An icon representing the keyword Dash]] [[:Dash|pulling]] him to them, during which they are [[File:Reveal icon.png|20px|link=Sight#Standard sight|An icon representing the keyword Standard sight]] [[:Sight#Standard sight|revealed]].
description.text: Active: Amumu throws a bandage in the target direction that deals magic damage to the first enemy hit, stunning them for 1 second and pulling him to them, during which they are revealed.

description2.raw: '''Amumu''' periodically [[stock]]s a ''Bandage Toss'' charge, up to a maximum of 2.
description2.text: Amumu periodically stocks a Bandage Toss charge, up to a maximum of 2.

notes.raw: * '''Amumu''' will track the target if they change locations. ** He will dash to the target's previous location if the target is 2000 or more units away or moves beyond 2000 units. * ''Bandage Toss'' will always be directed towards the target's location even if '''Amumu''' moves while it is in flight. * [[File:Stun icon.png|20px|link=Crowd_control#Immobilizing|An icon representing the keyword Immobilize]] [[:Crowd_control#Immobilizing|Immobilizing]] effects will not prevent '''Amumu''' from commencing the [[File:Dash.png|20px|link=Dash|An icon representing the keyword Dash]] [[:Dash|dash]]. * ''Bandage Toss'' does not fizzle on '''Amumu's''' [[File:Death icon.svg|20px|link=Death|An icon representing the keyword Death]] [[:Death|death]], and can still stun and damage enemies. * '''Amumu''' is still able to [[File:Dash.png|20px|link=Dash|An icon representing the keyword Dash]] [[:Dash|dash]] even if ''Bandage Toss'' is blocked by [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|spell shield]]. * '''Amumu''' will be ordered to basic attack the target upon completion of the dash. * This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time.
notes.text:
Amumu will track the target if they change locations.
* He will dash to the target's previous location if the target is 2000 or more units away or moves beyond 2000 units.
Bandage Toss will always be directed towards the target's location even if Amumu moves while it is in flight.
Immobilizing effects will not prevent Amumu from commencing the dash.
Bandage Toss does not fizzle on Amumu's death, and can still stun and damage enemies.
Amumu is still able to dash even if Bandage Toss is blocked by spell shield.
Amumu will be ordered to basic attack the target upon completion of the dash.
This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time.
